commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a finished landscape character-selection background illustration for the Junna Hoshimi playable-character mod in Slay the Spire 2.
Input image 1: identity, costume and art-direction reference ONLY. Create a new dynamic composition of the exact same character. Keep her recognizable face, violet-plum hair tied into a short low side ponytail with the little gold bell, green eyes behind thin round dark glasses, navy military-style stage jacket with gold trim, red diagonal chest sash, bright-blue pleated skirt with white stripe, long white asymmetric skirt tails, gold-trimmed dark boots, and flowing red cape with white fur edging. Keep her elegant slender proportions and covered stage uniform.
Scene: a vast midnight-blue theatrical stage, warm gold architecture, red velvet curtains, dramatic stage lights, stars and bow-and-arrow motifs derived from the reference. One Junna only.
Visual style: premium Japanese anime game key visual, precise expressive cel-shaded character with refined painterly atmospheric background; excellent draftsmanship, razor-clear glasses and eyes, clean hair strands, clean garment edges, vivid dark-to-light contrast, dynamic cinematic perspective. More spectacular and heroic than the reference.
Composition: wide 16:9 landscape, preferably 2560x1440 or the highest native landscape resolution available. Junna occupies the RIGHT half, with face around 70–77% of image width and 25–33% of image height. Her face, hands, bow and arrow tips remain clear inside the frame, with room around the silhouette. Keep the LEFT 40% dark, quiet and low detail for the existing character-name and statistics interface. The bottom LEFT 60% should stay visually quiet for character-choice icons. Keep bright special effects mainly in the right half. Full figure or dynamic near-full figure, tasteful non-sexual action pose.
Constraints: exactly one anatomically coherent character, two natural hands with correct fingers, one ornate recurved bow with green gem finial and one readable bowstring following the physical bow, plausible archery mechanics. Preserve the identity and costume. No UI, no logos, no lettering, no labels, no captions, no watermark. Avoid a collage, panels, photorealism, 3D renders, giant indistinct glowing blobs, excessive particle noise, unreadable weapon silhouettes, random extra straps or jewelry.

variants.name: 满弓瞄准
variants.prompt: Action and visual direction: a decisive three-quarter full-draw archery stance, body on the right, left hand holding the bow, right hand drawing the arrow back to the cheek. The arrow aims diagonally toward the upper-left, its clear luminous point near image center instead of crossing the empty UI far left. Junna's expression is intense and focused, eyes visible through clean glasses. A powerful electric blue and icy white starburst gathers at the arrowhead, elegant curved star trails and a few sparks sweep behind her, red cape whips to the right. Low-angle camera, dramatic foreshortening in the bow, crisp hand and string anatomy, luminous stage rings under her boots, navy background fading dark toward the left. The energy should feel concentrated, explosive and precise.

variants.name: 凌空放箭
variants.prompt: Action and visual direction: a dramatic airborne forward leap at the instant an arrow has just been released, body and bent legs filling the right half, long cape and white tails making one bold diagonal sweep to the upper-right. Junna's left hand still firmly grips the bow, right release hand elegantly opened beside her cheek, both hands clearly legible. One bright blue-white star-shaped arrow streaks from the right toward the upper-middle with a clean trailing arc; a few secondary star streaks frame her rather than clutter her face. Strong low-angle cinematic perspective, blue-white backlight against red cloth, rings of light and fragments of stage illumination below. Keep the face and hands in focus; speed is shown by fabric and the bright arrow trail. Strong action silhouette, wide-stage depth, dark left UI space.
revisionPrompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the attached image with one targeted correction: fix the single fired arrow and its trail so that they travel in the direction that the archer's bow actually points. The character is on the right, her bow hand and bow are at the far right, and her release hand is to the left of her head. REMOVE the luminous arrow currently flying toward the upper LEFT across the top of the scene and restore the clean dark theater ceiling there. Show a blue-white luminous arrow just beyond the bow grip on the RIGHT, flying diagonally toward the upper RIGHT, with its thin trail leading back through the bow grip toward her release hand. Keep the new arrowhead within the right edge of the frame. This must clearly read as an arrow just fired FORWARD from her bow. Preserve the exact face, green eyes, glasses, violet hair and golden bell, navy and gold stage uniform, red cape, white garment tails, airborne leg pose, bow and green jewel, lighting, stage, camera, native image dimensions, and quiet dark left-side UI space. No other additions or changes. No text, no watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Add one physically correct bowstring to the attached picture, and preserve everything else exactly. The gold recurve bow is on the right side of the airborne archer. Its upper nock is just beneath the green jewel near (1420,50) and lower nock is at the pointed bottom limb near (1200,620) in this 1672x941 image. Draw ONE thin, taut, silver-white bowstring as an elegant continuous straight line joining those two bow-limb tips. It should naturally pass in front of the red cape but respect the archer's hand and arm occlusion. The archer has just released her shot; the bowstring is relaxed straight between the bow's nocks. Preserve the blue-white arrow flying toward the upper right and its direction, her face, glasses, hair, hands, costume, red cape, airborne pose, stage lighting, all other details and the exact native dimensions. No new effects or text.

variants.name: 星轨环绕
variants.prompt: Action and visual direction: Junna stands in a poised grounded ready-to-fire stance on the right, turning toward the viewer with a confident intense gaze and head tilted slightly downward, ornate bow angled vertically beside her right-side silhouette. Her left hand grips the bow at the handle; her right hand visibly and naturally holds one physical arrow ready to nock. Several clean luminous icy-blue star-arrow trajectories form a large dynamic elliptical orbit behind and around her, like a long-exposure celestial archery performance; show a handful of distinct arrowheads travelling along those arcs, all with clear direction and spatial depth. One brilliant eight-point stage star behind her upper body, deep indigo stage, radiant blue rim light, saturated red cape flaring outward, gold accents, glossy reflected star paths under her boots. Constellation-scale spectacle while keeping face, hands and green bow jewel clear. All arc paths fade before entering the far-left UI area.

variants.name: 舞台逆光
variants.prompt: Action and visual direction: an imposing cinematic heroine entrance on the right, one boot stepping forward onto a luminous eight-point stage star, torso twisting into a bold ready stance and chin raised with a determined almost challenging gaze. Junna's left hand carries the curved bow diagonally with its lower limb near the bottom center and green gem finial high right; the right hand holds a single arrow angled downward beside her. A massive warm-gold spotlight cuts through deep blue haze behind her head and shoulders while icy-blue stage lights rim the bow, glasses, hair and boots; the red cape surges up and out behind her like a theatrical banner, the white tails fan cleanly around her knees. Tall gold theater arches recede dramatically, a bright star-shaped stage light high behind her, a sparse shower of gold star sparks confined to the right. Rich navy-red-gold cinematic contrast, very strong heroic silhouette, intense expressive face with visible green eyes. Broad left-side darkness, no lettering.
